free_tier.stated: No free tier. The page says to add credit and pay only for what is used, pricing Kimi-K3.1-Pro at USD 2.00 per 1M input and USD 10.00 per 1M output tokens.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the umans CLI, which authenticates through a browser, plus an OpenAI-compatible key
chaining: prepaid credit is the scarce link, since no allowance is granted at signup

limits.value: prepaid credit billed per token, USD 2.00 per 1M input and USD 10.00 per 1M output on the flagship model

identity_cost.detail: usage is prepaid by adding credit before a key is issued

reliability_note: the CLI opens a browser on first run, so an unattended host needs the key path instead

evidence.proved: the plan is prepaid per token with Kimi-K3.1-Pro at USD 2.00 per 1M input and USD 10.00 per 1M output and no free allowance
evidence.quote: Run Claude Code, Cursor, Zed, Copilot, OpenCode, Kilo Code, Pi, and more with one API key. Pay only for what you use. Add credit, create a key, and start coding. Currently serving **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash**, **Kimi K3.1 Pro**, and **GLM 5.3**.
